title: Samuel Brannan
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: The first Latter-day Saints entered the region during years of territorial conflict; between 1846 and 1850, the Alta California province of Mexico experienced a revolt and warfare, becoming variously the short-lived Republic of California, U.S. Territory of California, and ultimately the U.S. state of California. The largest collection of Samuel Brannan’s papers resides at L. Tom Perry Special Collections, Harold B. Lee Library, Brigham Young University, Provo, Utah.
